Name: Faust the Gravekeeper - Custom NPC
Author: SukuroIsUseless
Description:
[center][b][size=3]Custom NPC Mod For Some Guy I Made[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Feedback appre[size=3]ciated, as [/size]always![/i][/center]
[center][size=2]11/21: Storage device has gotten replace, and I've gotten SDV to run without overheating my laptop by taking out some big mods, so [/size][b][size=3]I can resume bug fixes and whatnot[/size][/b][size=3]![/size][size=2] [size=2]However, [/size][/size][b][size=3]I cannot work on anything related to issues that occur while using SVE until I get my fan replaced.[/size] [/b][size=2]Thank you for waiting, I'll try to fix issues that were previously put in the comments and bug reports now. Feel free to repeat an[size=2]y issues you had [/size]if I didn't notice them.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Same as the last update I put her[/size][b][size=2]e, [/size][size=3]I still have not been able to recover his 3.0.0 files[/size] [/b][size=2]from my broken storage device. It would probably be best to just start over from scratch at this point, but I really don't wanna have to recode those events and redraw the sprites for SPOILERS SPOILERS (because I suck at pixel art and drawing sprite sheets so bad), so until I either get the files back or finally change my mind, [/size][u][b][size=3]the 3.0.0 update for Faust is [i]still[/i] on indefinite hiatus.[/size][/b][/u][size=2] For anyone that's actually still waiting around for 3.0.0, I am incredibly grateful for your patience.[/size]
[/center]


[center][/center]
Faust is a gloomy young man who cares for the cemeteries in Pelican Town. Ever since he moved in, the only company he surrou[size=3]nds himself wit[/size]h is that of the ﻿graves he tends to. Though he holds no social relationships with any of the townsfolk, his loneliness seems to be self-inflicted. But by talking to him and throwing two ﻿gifts a week at him, maybe [i]you[/i] can get him to open up!



Because he lives up at the railroad, you [b]will not be able to interact with him[/b] [s]until the landslide clears on the 3rd of Summer.[/s] until you visit the railroad for the first time, and wait until the day after.

[u]If you notice any bugs, spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, or conflicting dialogue, please let me know![/u]

[size=3][u][b][i]One of his Heart Events contains mentions of suicidal thoughts. Just thought I should put a warning for that.[/i][/b][/u] [/size][size=2](Since it's just mentions and not that major of a thing, I'm not adding the NSFW tag cause I don't want him getting lumped together with all the gross NSFW mods 💀)[/size]

[center][size=2]~~[/size][/center]

This mod was initially made to require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], but no longer requires it. I would still recommend it if you want the intended experience or whatever, but you do you!

﻿Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] mod is recommended, since the style of his sprites are based around those + he has seasonal outfits.

[center]﻿~~[/center]
[center][/center]
This Mod Adds:
[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]One new NPC - Faust![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]  ﻿His dialogue, sprites, and portraits were all made by me.
﻿He even has seasonal outfits, plus one festival outfit so far![/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Events![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]Currently, Faust has his all of his Heart Events- [/size][b]excluding[/b][size=2] his 14 Heart Event- along with a 5 Heart Event and a few extra events. His 8 Heart Event is broken up into two halves.
﻿One of his extra events is an easter egg that is only accessible if you have certain mods installed.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][i][b]His own house![/b][/i][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]Faust has his own home, located up at the railroad, on the other side of the train tracks. It requires 2 hearts with him to enter, and is inaccessible until the landslide blocking off the railroad has cleared.
﻿In the configs, there is an option to change the position of his house just in case it conflicts with any other mods you have, or you simply don't like the position.[/size]

[size=3][u]NOTICE REGARDING AI:[/u] [/size][size=2]A while back, I discovered that someone had made AI generated portraits for Faust. At the time, I couldn't bring myself to bother figuring out how to request to get content taken down, so I convinced myself not to care about it. However, knowing that there is AI slop of the character I put time and love into making frankly ticks me off. I find generative AI to be disgusting, unethical, and an insult to creation itself. Do [b]NOT[/b] make AI portraits for Faust, do [b]NOT[/b] make AI translations for Faust, do [b]NOT [/b]make AI [i]anything[/i] related to Faust. I will do what[/size][size=2] I can to have it taken down when I find you distributing that crap of my character on Nexus.[/size]

Anyway, these can all be found in the [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] section of the [i]Requirements[/i] window, but in case you missed them, here are some lovely portrait mods made by [i]real,[/i] talented people!
